audit.whatIsWrong: Mantra is never named in either layer, and the whole page is written as if Karma's power curve looks like a normal champion's — the full layer even says 'Reassess his ultimate too' at level 6.
audit.why: Riot's Mantra text: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.' Karma has her ultimate from the first wave. Her level-1 poke can be a Mantra'd Inner Flame, and there is no level-6 power spike to wait out. It is 40/38/36/34 and Gathering Fire shortens it every time one of her damaging abilities lands on you, so dodging her Q is also how you keep Mantra off the board.
audit.corrected: Mantra named with its 40s cooldown and the level-1 availability in the level 1-2 spike, whys[0], the level-6 phase, the cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions; Gathering Fire added to wants.you and wants.foe.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tether-break rule sits in one line of the full layer ('breaks if you LoS / outrange it') with no distance, and the don't claims Focused Resolve 'catches you mid-dash'.
audit.why: Riot: 'Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy... If the tether is NOT broken, the enemy will be rooted.' Range 675, flat 12s at every rank. So the root is conditional and the condition is a number — 675 units — which is 150 less than your Winds of War at 825. Nothing supports the mid-dash claim.
audit.corrected: 675 tether-break distance and the flat 12s written into the level-3 spike, whys[1], the cooldown block, the do's, the don'ts, Key Ability Interactions and the loading tip; mid-dash claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Karma 'him/his' in ten places and its level-1 why claims Galio 'wins most level-1 exchanges' when the content layer correctly says the opposite.
audit.why: Inner Flame reaches 950 against Winds of War's 825 — she out-ranges Galio's only level-1 tool by 125 units and has Mantra on top. Galio does not win level 1 here.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed; level-1 phase and breakdown.early rewritten around the 950-vs-825 range gap so both layers agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization lists no anti-heal while the loading tip vaguely says 'Anti-heal if he sustains', despite _missing-interactions.json flagging this matchup for Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: The heal is a Mantra'd Focused Resolve — Riot: 'Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.' It is her only heal, so anti-heal matters specifically when she is holding Mantra, not as a general purchase.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb added to itemization and tied to her Mantra heal in the loading tip and the late-game block.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Focused Resolve' appears nine times with no cooldown.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12 seconds at every rank — it never gets shorter, so the punish window is identical from level 3 to level 18. Inner Flame is 9/8/7/6/5.
audit.corrected: Flat 12s attached at every mention across both layers.

notes: Biggest gap: Mantra was never named anywhere, and Riot's own text says it is 'available at level 1 and does not require a skill point'. The page was written as though Karma had a normal level-6 ultimate timer — she does not, so a Galio waiting for '6' is waiting for nothing while her Mantra'd Inner Flame is already live on wave one. Gathering Fire also shortens Mantra every time one of her damaging abilities lands, which makes dodging her Q worth more than the HP it saves. Second: the tether-break rule now carries its number — Focused Resolve is 675 range on a flat 12s, and it only roots 'if the tether is not broken', so the counterplay is walking 675 units, not surviving the root. Your Winds of War is 825, comfortably outside it. Note the sample here is small: MC_REAL_GAMES has only 93 games at 48.39%, matching the packet exactly, so the level chart should not be read as strongly as on the 1000-game matchups.
